name: The Little Bean — WA Chatbot (OpenRouter + Supabase )

assignments.name: chatHistory
assignments.value: ={{ $('Limit Chat History').all().map(i => ({ role: i.json.role, message: i.json.message })) }}

assignments.name: orderData
assignments.value: ={{ $('Latest Order Only').first()?.json?.order_summary ? 'Produk: ' + $('Latest Order Only').first().json.order_summary + '\nStatus: ' + $('Latest Order Only').first().json.status : 'Belum ada pesanan' }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
  "max_tokens": 500,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "messages": {{ (() => { const history = ($json.chatHistory || []).filter(h => h.role && h.message); const quoted = $json.quotedMessage ? '
[Pelanggan membalas pesan: "' + $json.quotedMessage + '"]' : ''; const orderContext = $json.orderData ? '

STATUS PESANAN TERAKHIR CUSTOMER INI:
' + $json.orderData : ''; const systemPrompt = $json.aiPrompt + '

KONTEKS BISNIS:
' + $json.businessContext + orderContext; const msgs = [{ role: 'system', content: systemPrompt }]; history.forEach(h => msgs.push({ role: h.role, content: h.message })); msgs.push({ role: 'user', content: $json.customerMessage + quoted }); return JSON.stringify(msgs); })() }}
}

parameters.name: text
parameters.value:
={{ '🔔 *PESANAN BARU - THE LITTLE BEAN!*

Dari: +' + $('Extract AI Reply').item.json.customerPhone.replace('@lid', '').replace('@c.us', '') + '
Waktu: ' + new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID', {timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta'}) + ' WIB

📦 Detail Pesanan:
' + $('Extract AI Reply').item.json.aiReply.replace('PESANAN_TERKONFIRMASI:', '').trim() + '

Segera diproses ya kak! 🙏' }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ Math.abs(new Date($json.last_message_time).getTime() - new Date($('Extract Message Data').item.json.timestamp).getTime()) }}
